release_notes: Build 63 recovers Website Link Tracker settings when the recorded development folder was renamed after migration, including names such as FactVaultManager-backup, FactVaultManager-old and similar sibling folders.
The renamed-folder pass uses the existing development-root marker to inspect matching sibling folders and recover factburst-link-tracker.json without modifying or deleting the backup folder.

Recovered tracker credentials still pass through the existing same-user protection and are saved into the installed app's persistent data folder; the tracker key is never logged or written into release metadata.
The recovery preserves any already-configured installed tracker and continues to respect previous successful recovery markers so deliberately cleared settings are not resurrected.
Regression coverage includes the exact case where development-root.txt points to FactVaultManager but the surviving tracker file is under FactVaultManager-backup/data.
